data.Q: Where is Uzziah buried in relation to his ancestors?
data.A: Near his ancestors, in the kings’ cemetery.

data.Q: What happens after Uzziah is buried?
What does Jotham do while Uzziah lives apart with leprosy?
data.A: Jotham runs the palace and governs the people.
data.wrong_answer: Jotham lives in a separate house, banned from the temple.

data.Q: Whose son is Jotham who governs the people?
Why is Uzziah buried near his ancestors, not with them?
data.A: Because people said he was leprous.
data.wrong_answer: Because the cemetery belongs to the kings.

data.Q: What does the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz do with Uzziah’s reign?
data.A: He records the other events from start to finish.
data.wrong_answer: He becomes king after Uzziah is buried.
